info.title: codemetrics
info.description: Quantitative C# code metrics: cyclomatic and cognitive complexity, Halstead volume, maintainability index, coupling, cohesion (LCOM4) and Robert Martin namespace metrics, with interpreted diagnoses. Part of the Dependably suite.

options.name: --format
options.description: human (default) or json to stdout (shared finding schema v1)

options.name: --json
options.description: also write full results as json to <file>

options.name: --no-semantic
options.description:
skip type/namespace metrics; syntactic only, constant memory,
no compilation (for very large repositories)

options.name: --no-dedup
options.description: do not collapse byte-identical files (dedup is on by default)

options.name: --exclude
options.description: skip paths matching glob (repeatable; substring if no wildcard)

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
exit 1 if any finding breaches; repeatable. Two forms:
severity=<critical|high|moderate|low|info> (any diagnosis at-or-
above the level), or <metric>=<number> where metric is
cyclomatic|cognitive|nesting|lcom4|coupling (max) or mi (min)

options.name: --config
options.description:
(.dependably-check is the deprecated alias filename). Discovered
from <path> up to the repo root when omitted; CLI
--fail-on/--exclude override/extend it.

options.name: --version
options.description: print the tool version and exit 0
